2.1.278 (Claude Code)
=== index line:
3:- [sandbox effects](ddaanet/sandbox-effects.md) — index.lock/"Another git process" (only a real lock survives unsandboxed), phantom dotfiles as char devices or zero-byte files (break `git add -A`; a porcelain cleanliness gate reads their `??` as DIRTY; one clean reading proves nothing), sibling worktree "Read-only file system", "Device or resource busy" on .claude/settings.json & .git/config, own hooks.json unlink EROFS, --resume "No conversation found…", $TMPDIR unset unsandboxed and unstable across sandboxed calls (hardcode /tmp/claude across a call or into a subagent directive), zellij "no active session", empty `ps` for background tasks, sandboxed `claude -p` drops every SessionStart hook, `apply-seccomp: unshare(CLONE_NEWUSER)` = sandbox init failed, /tmp "No space left"/du≪df = other sandboxes pin the tmpfs; escapes incl. dangerouslyDisableSandbox and `excludedCommands` (ONE matching segment unsandboxes the whole call, statically; does NOT auto-approve)
